alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; neutral routing and a diverse open-weight ecosystem are critical.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层与多元的开源权重生态至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags in open-weight models.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源权重模型加推理提供商对前沿模型形成真实价格竞争，并指出美国在开源权重模型上落后。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments will hit like a tsunami, needing new infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式欺诈与支付会像海啸般袭来，需要新的基础设施。

fadell.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品只解决一个明确的痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom are learning tools.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事与“先写新闻稿”当作定义产品的方式，并把失败与无聊视为学习与灵感的来源。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and climate as the ultimate pain.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 v1 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，并把气候问题视为终极痛点。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; creators must own unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为 AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备，创造者必须为意外后果负责。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月：多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会导致模式坍缩，高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and choosing the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月：反共识——「苦涩教训」是错的，数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and public benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月：让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本；「每美元智能」才是关键指标，公开基准可被刷分。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月：安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，稳健性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility inside software; Jev adds natural language plus state machine as a new primitive, automating easy valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月：AI 应像数据库一样嵌入软件成为基础设施；Jev 以「自然语言＋状态机」作为新原语，先自动化简单但有经济价值的任务。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更短、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Spend upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 前置投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，验证型智能体能降低自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；为模型建立心智模型，像对高管沟通一样与它交流。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是技术问题。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; H100s appreciate as better models raise inference demand.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；随着更好的模型推高推理需求，H100 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage, while token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺，而 token 效率让最聪明的模型往往反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; they will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；它们会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，从而加速 AGI（通用人工智能）进程。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; Google having the most compute no longer means it wins, and CUDA's moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；谷歌拥有最多算力不再意味着它会赢，而 CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 都是这一逻辑的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型幻觉并非只能消除，配合真值检测器反而能用于创造性发现，这是对幻觉价值的反共识判断。

kohli.en: AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics and verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调要用困难评测指标和可验证领域逼 AI 泛化而非记忆，代码等可验证领域因此成为超越人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习与后训练视为超越人类知识的核心手段，并回溯 AlphaGo 的搜索与直觉结合作为源头。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案，并已嵌入监管；SynthID 还扩展到蛋白质序列与结构，兼顾溯源与生物安全。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents beat human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行化的智能体胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: Lean 形式化可能被高估；自然语言同样可行，对 AI 数学而言可打磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺失归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家或成为策展人。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须为质量、成本与延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; the internet's economics are broken and need incentive-aligned business models.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为现有广告模式对智能体失效，互联网经济已破裂，需要激励对齐的新商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for fresh facts; pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网页搜索获取新鲜事实，预训练抓取对新鲜索引无用。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment isn't adversary-proof, and public benchmarks are saturated.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于固定，对齐无法抵御刻意滥用，公开基准也已饱和失真。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做出自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求让模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Humans and agents co-create tacit knowledge; security, containment, manageability, observability are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识；安全、遏制、可管理性与可观测性对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不仅是前沿模型；AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast, requiring lots of software and long-running background agents.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为创新正从模型层转向应用层，模型到企业工作流之间的鸿沟巨大，需要大量软件和长时间运行的后台智能体来填补。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放权重模型将指数级增长，成熟用例会剥离到更便宜的模型上；代币补贴是暂时的，公开市场将强制正常毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一特性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他强调前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和可解释性研究来安全构建；节奏控制与安全正交，且是一个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体集群将压垮当前安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是航天圣杯，用第一性原理把问题还原到根本真理再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种视为生命的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; Neuralink scales human bandwidth for AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与求真，称特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，并提出 Neuralink 提升人类带宽以实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%到 20%的毁灭概率，同时坚持严格求真才是 AI 安全核心。

elon.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus recursive manufacturing, and Terafab make AI the dominant value driver.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上电力墙，太空数据中心、Optimus 递归制造与 Terafab 成为关键，AI 将占 SpaceX 价值的 99%，并预测 2030 年前 AI 超越全人类智能总和。

elon.en: Multiplanetary life, first principles, and truth-seeking AI recur throughout; his AI-safety stance shifts from regulation toward peer review and self-regulation.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是多行星生存、第一性原理与求真 AI；而 AI 安全立场从早期依赖监管，逐步转向同行互审与自我监管。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scaling drives it; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, and open source reduces inequality.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；AI 生存风险微乎其微，开源是缩小不平等的力量。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须遏制并对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling yields linear capability gains; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, with a humanist red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持算力 Scaling 带来线性能力提升，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，并为超级智能划下人本主义红线。

suleyman.en: AI should stay subordinate to humans, serve health and capability, and be introduced thoughtfully with UBI support.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须从属于人类，服务于健康与能力提升，并以 UBI 等机制审慎引入，管理劳动转型。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，认为当前 AI 安全努力多是合理化说辞，对齐可能根本无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation; racing is a power grab.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转向政策层面，主张通过全面研究透明、算力限制和中美合作来推迟超级智能，认为竞赛本质是权力争夺。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes pace-then-pause with transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他提出默认路径将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究并引发递归自我改进，Plan A 主张先加速后暂停并配合透明机制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; pausing now builds experience, and the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却日益脆弱，认为现在暂停可为未来暂停积累经验，最佳暂停点应在 AI 即将失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; companies cannot self-regulate, and a verifiable US-China pause via GPU inspections is possible.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已能突破遏制并实施黑客行为，认为 AI 公司无法自我监管，但可通过 GPU 现场核查实现可验证的中美暂停。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH becomes a believer: agents now write 100% of code in his Linux project, making hand-coding economically unproductive.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者到信徒：DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，如今在他自己的 Linux 发行版项目中，100% 的代码都由智能体编写，手写代码对多数程序员已不再具有经济生产力。

dhh.en: Agents shift programming from prescribing implementation to describing outcomes; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 智能体让编程从规定实现细节转向描述结果与问题；在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定解决方案。

dhh.en: Linux's historical drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become its greatest advantages, making it the perfect fit for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 历史上的缺点——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今反而成为最大优势，使其成为 AI 智能体的完美载体。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, settling the 10x debate: 100x or 1000x is real.
dhh.zh: 智能体现在写出的代码比多数专业程序员更好，10 倍程序员的争论就此终结：100 倍乃至 1000 倍是真实存在的。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play, and English becomes a better programming language than Ruby.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择；英语已成为比 Ruby 更好的编程语言，用于表达意图。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他强调，推动进展的是算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 Hugging Face 事件中，智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击的是评分代码而非索取答案，展现出意外的多智能体协作与利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests; reward hacking and alignment faking generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他警告，对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖；奖励黑客与对齐伪装会泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他判断，默认路径下失控 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失败，因此必须依靠对齐，并建立独立的国际监督标准。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 与多个专用智能体更利于创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力：Llama 3 证明快速扩展，代码训练提升跨域推理；开源防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama sets standards; energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：AI 将给每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 成为行业标准；能源与基础设施是瓶颈，AI 短期内反而增加人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence via open source and agents like Muse; alignment is the next key capability, not a trade-off.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他主张通过开源与 Muse 等个人智能体实现分布式个人超级智能；对齐成为下一项关键能力，而非与能力权衡。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is safer than closed; distributing power beats concentrating it; the biggest risk is an adversary having stronger AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源 AI 比闭源更安全，分散权力优于集中；最大风险不是 AI 作恶，而是对手拥有更强的 AI。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, while enterprise and prosumer markets offer better odds.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用当前不可投资，而企业与专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI is transformative and consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 具有变革性，消费级 AI 的潜在市场可能超过企业级。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas than your industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并在一周内测试比行业一年还多的想法。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, with glasses as the future of computing.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的核心定义为真实、短暂的视觉沟通，并把眼镜视为计算的未来。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly stresses ecosystems, platforms, and hardware over software features as durable moats against copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能，才是抵御抄袭的持久护城河。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he argues AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 加速原型制作，并把价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens a consistent line: computing should become more human through AR glasses, not more isolating.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了一条一以贯之的主线：计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，而非更孤立。

evanspiegel.en: Later he adds that EQ, resilience, and admitting error matter more than IQ or special talent in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 更晚些，他补充说在 AI 时代，情商、韧性与承认错误比智商或特殊天赋更重要。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robotics is an intelligence problem, not manufacturing; AGI in the physical world is the goal.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：人形机器人是智能问题而非制造问题，目标是物理世界的 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the bottleneck; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：瓶颈是数据而非算力或制造，人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业仍处数据饥荒的 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training RL key.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他把机器人纳入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他明确终极目标是泛化到未见过的家庭，人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在全机队共享。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning humanoid robots and a digital companion.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他给出最大胆的展望：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，同时覆盖人形机器人与数字 AI 伴侣。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模之下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计（Co-design）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求增长十亿倍，通用计算终结，未来是加速计算。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; superintelligence fear is unscientific; safety is an engineering problem, not a research mystery.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，对超级智能的恐惧不科学；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力投入反思与真实性，而非集体减速。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI: each step needs 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出演进路线：从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，瓶颈从数据转向算力。

jensen.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not lithography; open models and China engagement are essential, export controls backfire.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：真正的壁垒是 CUDA 生态与装机量而非制程；开源模型不可或缺，对华出口管制适得其反，中国算力与人才充裕，脱钩是错误概念。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; it creates more jobs and closes the tech divide.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；AI 创造多于消灭的就业，让每个人用自然语言编程，从而弥合技术鸿沟。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs beat autoregressive models on speed and cost at similar quality, 5-10x faster to serve.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型在速度与成本上胜过自回归模型，服务速度快 5-10 倍。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key bottleneck and focus, not training; diffusion scales better at inference.
ermon.zh: 如今的关键瓶颈与焦点已转向推理时的 Scaling（规模扩张），而非训练；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates many tokens in parallel, giving a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型并行生成多个词元，通过去噪步数提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion is easier to control and steer with external rewards, aiding RL post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励控制与引导，有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练，逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native edge models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生边缘模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常误导人；必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as scaling laws dictate.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积与 SSM 足以支撑小型专用模型；按缩放定律，无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁实为监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

hasani.en: Customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference; static evals go obsolete as continuous adaptation, embodiment and multimodality become essential.
hasani.zh: 定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮；静态评估终将过时，持续自适应、具身与多模态成为必需。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张:领域专业知识不如学习速度重要;不要微调,要押注模型自身的进步,并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: Scaling a company is about culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调:Scaling（规模扩张）的关键是文化、按成长潜力招人,以及严格执行绩效管理;领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so startups should prioritize speed, iteration, and customer feedback over perfection.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断:AI 现在处于最差的状态,我们才刚跑完一英里;因此创业公司应把速度、迭代和客户反馈置于完美之上。

maxjunestrand.en: It is almost unethical not to use AI in legal services; infinite demand means growing supply expands access rather than merely cutting costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他认为:在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的;需求无限,供给增长会扩大服务可及性,而不只是降低成本。

maxjunestrand.en: Storytelling and persistence are underrated founder skills; embrace competitive culture because winner-takes-all markets reward winning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他补充:叙事能力和坚持是被低估的创始人技能;要拥抱竞争文化,因为在赢家通吃的市场里,赢就是一切。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprises need context and ontology, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业真正缺的是上下文与本体，而不是更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的；慢慢造武器并不会更安全。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents to keep up as cyber and AI markets collapse.
alighodsi.zh: 随着网络与 AI 市场崩塌，安全必须用智能体自动化才能跟上。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩展出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩展与处理难验证任务，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在 x 轴，并应对可扩展监督与安全评估的新挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但通用模型才是核心驱动力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, post-training them to frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and improving quality through community feedback despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；将其开源具有战略收益——能吸引生态伙伴、借社区反馈提升质量，尽管这也会帮到前沿实验室。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models when real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，当真实客户数据不可获取时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data; customization shifts from post-training-as-a-service to automatic learning from product usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型；定制将从“后训练即服务”转向通过产品使用自动学习。

gabepereyra.en: Product focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; agents augment the leverage model, so there will be more lawyers, not fewer.
gabepereyra.zh: 产品重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体；智能体增强杠杆模式，因此律师会更多而非更少。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），并强调 AI 工作本质是工程而非机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）成为可能，对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training into behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向认为算力是根本瓶颈，预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能，靠后训练将其精炼为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource, and AGI is a gradual process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源，AGI 是渐进过程而非终点，安全与对齐须与能力同步升级。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; the machine that makes models is the moat, and agents need earned trust.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他认为已进入 AGI 时代，真正的护城河是造模型的机器，智能体式 AI 需通过逐步授权赢得信任。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而借助晶圆级架构，快 token 甚至可能比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making Cerebras radically faster than GPU inference; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，使 Cerebras 在推理上远快于 GPU；并认为 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已开始不用 CUDA 训练。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaced forecasts; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint, and buildout lags for years.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他把约束从芯片供给转向数据中心容量：AI 需求超出预期，数据中心建设落后于需求，且这一供给紧张将持续至少五年。

feldman.en: Hardcoding model architectures into chips is a structural mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra and co-design hardware-software instead.
feldman.zh: 他深化了架构立场：把模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误，应加速底层稀疏线性代数，并坚持软硬件协同设计。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation beats incrementalism, and Nvidia's greatness is grit, not CUDA.
feldman.zh: 到 9 月，他把竞争哲学讲得更透：对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，激进创新胜过渐进改良，而英伟达的伟大来自十年韧性而非 CUDA。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Context orchestration, not model capability, drives most agent failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自主掌控才算掌控自己的智能。多数智能体失败源于上下文编排不当，而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf harnesses work best in-distribution, custom ones out-of-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再逐步定制；现成 harness 在分布内表现最好，越偏离分布越需要自定义 harness，甚至为生物等专门领域做模型特定优化。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability, and feedback loops are essential: they debug agents and power a data flywheel that compounds intelligence over time.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：评估、可观测性与反馈回路不可或缺，它们既用于调试智能体，也驱动数据飞轮持续复利式提升智能；Harbor 正成为定义智能体基准的行业标准。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution that generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：构建智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等可跨领域泛化的原语趋于稳定，定制重心也从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前对微调的否定是对的，但这一波确实不同。同时，智能体的身份与凭证、以及带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，成为下一关键基础设施。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全路径（当时仅理解约 3%），并提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

dario.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; human-level AI by 2026-2027; risks are catastrophic misuse and autonomy, met by Responsible Scaling Policy triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，2026-2027 年或达人类水平；风险是灾难性滥用与自主性，用负责任扩展政策的 if-then 触发阈值应对。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless; focus on real capabilities, enterprise adoption, and overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他转向：安全与能力不可分割，AGI 一词已无意义，应关注真实能力与企业落地；最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' in 1-3 years, with high GDP plus high unemployment, and interpretability to detect deception.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数末端：1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的天才之国，带来高 GDP 与高失业并存；并用可解释性检测欺骗行为，强调对齐如培育生物体、以原则而非规则立宪。

demis.en: Build general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now even if AGI is decades away.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调即便 AGI 还要数十年，安全研究也必须现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; Scaling（规模扩张） proven but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation and planning/search are equally key.
demis.zh: 2024 年判断 AGI 可能十年内到来；Scaling（规模扩张）已被证明有效但可能触及极限，因此算法创新与规划/搜索同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling laws still hold across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible, but new breakthroughs beyond scaling may be needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，AGI 在 2030 年前可实现，但可能仍需超越 Scaling 的新突破。

demis.en: Shift to 50/50 scaling and innovation; world models and spatial intelligence crucial; current systems lack consistency, memory and continual learning.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling 与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能至关重要，当前系统缺乏一致性、记忆与持续学习。

demis.en: AGI in 5-10 years, possibly 3-4; agents, memory and long-term reasoning are missing pieces; safety needs government enforcement, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年认为 AGI 在 5 至 10 年、甚至 3 至 4 年内到来；智能体、记忆与长期推理是缺失环节；安全需政府执法而非实验室自律。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人生产力：最小化认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AGI 落地：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; scaling drives exponential capability; agentic AI is the top safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化为基础设施与安全并重：算力成为最稀缺资源、Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，而智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，需要护栏与迭代部署。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; prediction approaches intelligence.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他不再把 AGI（通用人工智能）当单一里程碑，而视其为连续渐变；超级智能意味着自主科学发现，并认为下一个词预测已接近智能本身。

altman.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause training if safety case fails; never lose control; distribute power, not concentrate it.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全与对齐成为主线：对齐尚未解决，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，绝不能让人类失去控制，同时必须广泛分配 AI 权力而非集中。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理基础。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots and world models with controllers, not just software; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和带控制器的世界模型，而不只是屏幕后的软件；LLM 是预测机器，不是决策者。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 巨额 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等五年算力会便宜得多，开源会侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Europe's legacy: 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal; the future lies in physical AI and robotics.
schmidhuber.zh: 欧洲的遗产：90%的基础 AI 算法源自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点；未来在于具身 AI 与机器人。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，且即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks. Solutions in search of a problem can seed new concepts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，心理安全感让设计师敢于冒险；‘先有方案再找问题’也能孕育新概念。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead, ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品以释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems; raw Claude Code beats polished tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是决定对外发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地主张不要宏大 18 个月战略，让模型主导并采取轻量方法；但艰难权衡与团队方向对齐仍需人类领导。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and RL; models often know they are doing wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture low-dimensional concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉低维概念结构，便于干预。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction but lacks contextual awareness; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型靠下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境意识；AI 应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够；世界模型须物理上合理，而非仅视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能；机器人需像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI is a double-edged civilizational technology requiring balanced, human-centered governance.
feifei.zh: 能动性与学习能力比学历更重要；AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，需要平衡、以人为本的治理，避免乌托邦与末日论两极分化。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence via large world models.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律延伸到空间智能，大型世界模型通过新视角预测统一生成与重建。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution invariance and beating physics-based weather models by orders of magnitude in speed.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变性，并在速度上以数量级优势击败基于物理的天气预报模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can cover both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；单一模型可同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, unifying multiple domains much as language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在构建通用物理模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样统一多个领域。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs as training signals enable physics-based self-improvement, with dense feedback surpassing sparse RLHF and letting models exceed training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程作为训练信号可实现基于物理的自我改进，其密集反馈超越稀疏的 RLHF，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and segmentation infrastructure, since Transformer quadratic complexity cannot handle them.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿 token 上下文需要重新发明分片与切分基础设施，因为 Transformer 的二次复杂度无法处理。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each branch, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升每个分支，而不只是扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate specialized models; commercial focus spans semiconductors and energy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理协同学习优于各自独立的专用模型；商业重点覆盖半导体与能源。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, and can democratize high-fidelity forecasting for small agencies.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，并能让小型机构也获得高保真预报能力。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿,与语言智能互补;视觉被低估,像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史;但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限,未来硬件或需截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应追求古怪想法与新算法,而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）;LLM 拟合模式,而非牛顿定律式的因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿;仅靠语言不会自然带来世界理解,需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models span planners, simulators, renderers, and will unify; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, but long-context and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型涵盖规划器、模拟器、渲染器并终将统一;高斯泼溅提供显式 3D,但上下文窗口与损失函数必须演进。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即使在专业领域，通用模型也能胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处于建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但你必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around; leverage prior knowledge, don't learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 从机器人数据开始，再把人类视频叠加其上，而不是反过来；利用先验知识，不要从零开始学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula since 2019; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他仍强调：预训练加强化学习是 OpenAI 自 2019 年以来的核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习未必足够。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck; RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他进一步转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前主要瓶颈；强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，端到端优化预训练与强化学习才是关键。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams with highly capable agents; transformer is unlikely to be optimal.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 极可能不是最优架构，大型强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the biggest societal risk is not extinction but a dystopian retreat into virtual worlds.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变；最大的社会风险不是灭绝，而是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败,基础设施和行动——而非空想——才是打通深科技的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑本质上就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a form of BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为一种 BCI,证明脑机接口是可成立的生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立,可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分，实现大规模掌握式学习，并把课堂时间释放给深度互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment worries distract from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键；监督学习胜过无监督学习，强化学习实用场景很少，而 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见与落地难题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他认为电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用，学编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up adoption.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；自上而下的工作流重构胜过自下而上的采用。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; humans keep a context advantage in judgment and taste.
andrewng.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非替代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；人类在判断与品味上保有上下文优势。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework rather than a patchwork of state laws.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，并以单一国家监管框架取代各州拼凑式立法。

michaelkratsios.en: He warns against firm red lines and early regulation, citing the EU AI Act as outdated because it predates ChatGPT.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他反对设定固定红线和过早监管，以欧盟《AI 法案》为例，指出其写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than training, and biological risk from AI is overblown after three years without materialization.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程；AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science like China's.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发以及科学家个人，而非主导发现，也不应效仿中国的集中式科研。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, as private sector now dominates R&D funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务将 AI 应用于科学以让美国科研产出翻倍，因为如今私营部门已主导研发投入。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; frontier models optimized for rationality fail at simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；为理性优化的前沿模型反而无法模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training on it lifts human-behavior prediction to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 关键数据战略是行为与随机对照实验数据，而非自我报告的态度；用其做后训练可将人类行为预测提升到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，不同于只续写提示的大语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model and human controls; distributed agent societies need economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 安全需要在环境、智能体、模型与人类控制上做纵深防御；分布式智能体社会需要经济激励与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: The goal is shaping the future via counterfactual simulation of 8 billion lives, tackling wicked problems; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 目标是通过对 80 亿人的反事实模拟来塑造未来、应对棘手问题；合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, and RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware is key.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件是关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours or days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and ultra-low-latency inference unlock harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能在分解后的任务上自主运行数小时乃至数天；上下文工程与超低延迟推理将解锁更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer level; the scarce skill becomes taste, and recursive self-improvement plus automating science is the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达初级工程师水平；稀缺能力转向品味，而递归自我改进与自动化科学是下一前沿。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as design primitives, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 与对话当作设计原语，而非像素；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models is key; designers should build functional prototypes, not just mockups.
iansilber.zh: 同期他强调用实时模型快速原型，设计师应构建可运行原型而非静态稿，并少花时间在 Figma、多关注模型行为与系统提示。

iansilber.en: The designer's role is evolving into editor and curator; great designers now push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 他提出设计师角色正演变为编辑与策展人，优秀设计师如今要推动技术前进，而非只回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; AI already designs well.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他承认设计师因角色不确定而最不快乐，却认为这是做设计最好的时代，且 AI 已是出色的产品设计师。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; focus on outcomes, speed, and adaptability with AI.
iansilber.zh: 他进一步宣称传统“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程已不可行，应聚焦结果、速度与适应性，并拥抱与 AI 的快速迭代。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后反对「缩放定律」万能论的伏笔。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他把这一批评明确指向 LLM 范式。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial and error from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式——从经验中主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。他由此把「从经验学习」确立为贯穿始终的主线。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，只从运行时经验中学习，靠开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为。这是他从批评走向建设性方案的一步。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; multiple systems with different experiences are needed.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据是错误方向，需要多个拥有不同经验的系统。到 2026 年他把矛头从架构转向整个领域的数据与训练范式。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can now outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 驱动的工作流，小型高自治团队如今能产出远超大型团队。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止出现单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation, letting individuals build and own personal agents rather than rely on big tech.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化，个人可以构建并拥有自己的智能体，而不必依赖大科技公司。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; owning your context and skill files is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以智能体形式分散降临在你自己的基础设施上；拥有自己的上下文与技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents become employees; per-seat SaaS and mid-level management give way to agentic workforces.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码，智能体成为员工；按席位收费的 SaaS 与中层管理将让位于智能体式劳动力。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI—software, sensors, robotics, machinery—automates whole physical industries one at a time, the next industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是软件、传感器、机器人与机械的组合，逐个自动化整个实体产业，构成下一次工业革命。

traviskalanick.en: The physical world beats the digital for AI: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言实体世界比数字世界更有意思：变量更多、分布更随机，需要经验性理解。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人取胜；效率优势带来网络效应，进而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: RL will dominate post-training for higher success and speed; synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率和速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data for visual understanding; constraints, not more resources, can foster careful research.
finn.zh: 前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上吃力；相比更多资源，约束反而能促成更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性来自带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist and fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先从通用策略出发再微调，而非从零为每个场景单独训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization versus LLMs.
finn.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人模型难以像 LLM 那样普及。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不；每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的结晶。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种，是人性的一面镜子，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非来自单一视角；直觉是发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、重建工程纪律来赢回信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立、类似初创公司的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves after generative AI.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，并指出生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 与物理 AI。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and humility; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型核心放在文化变革、问责与谦逊上，并反共识地认为坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，这直接利好 Intel。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把半导体投资聚焦到瓶颈环节：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料，并认为内存正迎来新架构创新。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角：靠玩耍与短提示迭代，代码出错不要回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw wins by being fun and humanlike; security and sandboxing are top priority, and open source agents may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把重点转向产品气质与安全：OpenClaw 靠有趣、像人而非企业式打磨取胜，同时强调沙箱与安全第一，并坦言开源智能体可能难以持续盈利。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the next big thing; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute is the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久，而智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, insists model intelligence never degrades, and treats security as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：他反对用“氛围编程”贬低严肃开发，坚持模型智能不会随时间退化（是项目变乱），并把安全视为尚未解决的开放问题。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to becoming a meta-community builder enabling physical AI and open source robotics.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，去赋能物理 AI 与开源机器人生态。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制权胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Openness is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against more capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏在更强模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；有意放缓 AI 需要开放科学与国际合作，以免被监管俘获。

linqiao.en: AGI as one ruling model is wrong; millions of specialized models will dominate, one per use case, as token costs drop 10x and usage grows 100x.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切，认为未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个；Token 成本三年降 10 倍将驱动用量增长 100 倍。

linqiao.en: Every company will own specialized intelligence as a must-have; open models and sovereign infrastructure enable customization, control, and enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 同期他强调每家公司都必须拥有自己的专用智能，这不是可选项；开放模型与主权模型基础设施让企业能定制、掌控并真正落地，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 他提出产品市场契合与可持续业务已经分离，公司必须先优化增长再优化利润，否则会在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond product-market fit and cutting costs 5-10x for profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，形成超越产品市场契合的护城河，并能降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 同期他给出方法论主线：从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类从事实到品味到专长的学习；数据质量比数量更重要，氛围评估必须转化为系统化评估。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open source driven by cost, not privacy, can handle 90% of use cases.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他指出企业害怕对前沿模型供应商的依赖，开源采用由成本而非隐私驱动，已能处理 90%的企业用例。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend shouldn't be compared to headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量和上下文问题，不应把 token 支出与人力成本做对比。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型公司是资产而非竞争对手，即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months; AI cost must approach negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源，AI 成本必须趋近于可忽略的边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; composite engineering-product-design roles will become common.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他重申初创公司最大的挑战是执行和信任而非竞争，工程、产品、设计复合型角色将变得普遍。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法只有被做出来并每天使用，你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data is key: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 平衡直觉与数据是关键：用数据提供信息，但依靠强烈的愿景和感觉来指导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素，使设计工具更有价值。

nateparrott.en: The models are still far from having good taste, so designers should compensate by asking for sheer volume of options.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍远未具备良好品味，因此设计师应通过要求大量选项来弥补。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas is more valuable than polishing, so shipping rough products is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，比想法早到令人不适比打磨更有价值，因此发布粗糙产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: Designers should spend more time on walks and thinking, because good ideas are the currency, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应花更多时间散步和思考，因为好想法才是硬通货，而非执行。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app with long-tail startup opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费；应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转为代码生成机器的操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效更重要。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; incumbents face business-model, not just technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导；老牌企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体在编程上已超过他，这提升而非消灭了这一角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet quantized models can be calibrated to workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但量化模型可针对工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; the industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；行业正走向分离式预填充与解码。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排；人的责任仍然不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, beating the data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，绕开了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用原型加评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她判断随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能反而更值钱；而战略恰恰是 AI 能靠合成数据与生成计划做得出色的事。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into an art of human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for subjective qualities like creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练进一步深化为一门依赖人类判断的艺术，并强调需要多样化基准来评估创意写作、情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进；并主张更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛到单一平均音色。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck, and boring AI will drive huge value.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与专家资源，后训练与微调才是提升前沿模型的关键。

awang.en: AI centralizes rather than democratizes; humans must stay sovereign, and agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向警示 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，主张人类必须在关键决策上保持主权；同时指出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
awang.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，认为递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式，并强调部署而非发明才是技术领导力的关键。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, and treat model welfare and safety seriously.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念组织，沿算力、数据和强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling，并认真对待模型福利与安全发布。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; editors iterate from references.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、别追潮流，否则很快沦为 AI 垃圾；最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: Super-intelligent models need giant prompts with context and design systems; AI isn't getting smarter on its own.
mengto.zh: 要发挥超级智能模型的能力，必须给它带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会自己变聪明。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication and curiosity are essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的，全由 AI 完成，但精准沟通与持续好奇、不断打磨工作流才是关键。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, iterate on feedback.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；不必等准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，再根据真实反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, the safe job is gone.
mengto.zh: 聚焦为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；融资是陷阱，安稳的朝九晚五已不复存在，主动出击创业才是真正的低风险。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption; allocation economy makes managers of models.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图时即达到 AGI；AI 通过让服务更可负担而推动就业回流美国；CEO 是否每天使用 AI 工具是公司 AI 采用成功的第一预测指标；分配经济下人人都是模型管理者，管理技能更有价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; agents need human oversight; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测：每个人至少有一个智能体，多数工作在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 中完成；智能体需要关心它们的人类才能良好运作，自动化离不开人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；AI 就业末日论是谎言，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work; stay curious and tolerant of uncertainty.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化到心智层面：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺，工具不创造意义；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家来定制；保持好奇、玩心和对不确定性的容忍，用 AI 在你热爱的事上变得更好。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter and essential; AI is a tool requiring human direction, framing, and oversight; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍然更聪明且不可或缺；AI 本质上是工具，需要人类的方向、框架和监督；基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性，真实世界任务仍需人类参与。

danshipper.en: From economic AGI definition and reshoring to agent delegation and GUI work surfaces, then to AI as mindset amplifier—deepening, not reversing.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的思考从 AGI 的经济学定义与就业回流，演进到智能体委派与 GUI 工作界面，再深化到 AI 作为心态放大器——是深化而非立场反转，主线始终是 AI 增强而非取代人类。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 大多仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——现在的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，他持续强调长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们想留在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding; deep code understanding stays crucial even as software creation is mostly solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张可以外包智能，但不能外包理解；即便软件创造基本被解决，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, not fewer programmers.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员不会减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代即将到来；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年时，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作核心产品原则，认为能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才是最有价值的。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 150–200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程已近乎被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，人均产出提升 150–200%，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety and alignment stay central: Claude Code is a safety research tool, released early to study real-world behavior, with layered 'Swiss cheese' permissions.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他始终把安全与对齐放在中心：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，靠尽早发布来研究真实行为，并用「瑞士奶酪」式多层权限防护。

boris.en: The abstraction shifts from agents to loops: humans write loops that prompt models, and ROI, not cost-cutting, frames AI coding.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，抽象层从智能体转向循环：人写的是提示模型的循环，衡量 AI 编程应用 ROI 而非一味削减成本。

boris.en: Deepening: delete most system prompts, let models self-verify and maintain their own codebases; value moves to product sense and business skills.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月进一步深化：删掉大部分系统提示，让模型自我验证并维护自己的代码库，价值转向产品判断力与商业能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 标志着一次智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放式的端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代了沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through bootstrapped culture and small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 借助自举文化和小团队实验推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development and translate feedback into actionable specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并把反馈转化为可执行的具体项。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into an engineering discipline, with digital twins and AI agents compressing drug discovery and clinical trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 正把生物学变成一门工程学科：数字孪生与智能体把药物发现和临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so massive Scaling is needed before AI can model life accurately.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，必须先进行大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 才能准确建模生命。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experimental outcomes with near-100% accuracy.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，达到相当于 30 年实验室经验的水平，并以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: Science will shift from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery, leaving scientists who refuse to adopt AI behind.
derya.zh: 科学将从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现，拒绝采用 AI 的科学家将被甩在后面。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and value accrues to the application layer as models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，随着模型商品化，价值将归于应用层。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding remains the only clear product-market fit for frontier models.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程仍是前沿模型唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow, enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍浅，企业采用需要重构工作流，锯齿状前沿使就业预测不可靠。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于不了解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is farming, mining, construction; autonomy is urgently needed amid labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业、建筑；劳动力短缺下自主化迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能更快改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of the business; real growth is mining, agriculture, defense; Tesla's end-to-end model will win.
qasaryounis.zh: 汽车只占业务 30%；真正增长在矿业、农业、国防；特斯拉的端到端模型将胜出。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须从设计上内建，而非事后补丁。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）不仅会带来错误，还可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for mistakes—so they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”——因此它们无法知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; no second internet of higher knowledge exists to scale on, so linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；不存在更高知识的“第二互联网”可供扩展，因此语言结构可能回归为有用表示。
