catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly shipping; product taste becomes the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调 PM 必须放弃长期路线图、转向每周甚至每日交付；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and a clear internal bar for shipping.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他反复把「安全 AGI」使命当作 Anthropic 的统一主线，让跨组织决策更快、内部交付标准更清晰。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，自己专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调吃自己的狗粮与评测套件是每个功能的发布闸门；前沿模型反而需要更少的提示示例和硬约束，系统提示缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他给出反共识判断：重写现在是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明，只要测试套件够好，重写完全可行。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全环境中；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，因此 API 常优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills; politeness to agents improves outcomes, as with human employees.
clairevo.zh: 管理技能——角色界定与入职引导——比技术技能更重要；对智能体保持礼貌能改善结果，正如对待人类员工。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务；创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and project-manage humans, reversing the usual dynamic; yet human accountability and authorship of your life remain essential.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以拥有结果并反向管理人类任务，逆转通常的人机动态；但人类问责与对自己人生的作者身份仍然不可或缺。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他认为模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 他反共识地判断，未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个用户或团队训练个性化模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 他强调事实与技能不可分割：把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步深化：效率与智能不可分割，以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, with personalized continual learning on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 他指出当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；模型应自主学会哪些存进权重、哪些留作文本，并让个性化持续学习在设备端运行、由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业经验反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship erodes.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，随着学徒制瓦解，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再局限于来回对话式的提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI forfeits expertise-building, so experts and new formal assessment are needed more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会丧失构建专长的机会，因此专家与新的正式评估比以往更被需要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自对弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极难；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续数年的窗口而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比单纯堆算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 本身有感知并关怀生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为产品构建者，但对既有代码库的生产力提升仍然有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code, with visual-first design moving pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将把拉取请求推向生产。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results; the human remains the judge of what is good, and design is not dead.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果；人类仍是好坏的裁判，设计并未消亡。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting into new interfaces; jailbreaking is understudied and needs more incentives for battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词，演进出新界面；越狱研究不足，需要更多激励来做实战检验。

dylanfield.en: Follow the user workflow rather than TAM; build a point of view not everyone agrees with, and let leaders build to inspire teams.
dylanfield.zh: 应跟随用户工作流而非 TAM；建立并非人人认同的观点，并让领导者亲手构建以激励团队。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and the super-empowered individual will combine skills with AI.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，在人口下降之际出现堪称奇迹；超级赋能的个体将借助 AI 组合多种技能。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and human workers will be at a premium due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作的存续比任务更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失，且因人口减少，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing fast.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，且模型正快速商品化。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说出你对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里世界上最好的老师；悲观听起来高深，却常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so deterrence now depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并不客观；它们嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此威慑如今取决于创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论不过是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
naval.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席，是一种可习得的个人技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown, and open source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 是防止权力集中的关键。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software, shifting the moat to hardware, models, and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

naval.en: Scaling continues: inference compute may rise 90,000x; open source trails frontier models by only 3-6 months.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）判断：推理算力或增长 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3 到 6 个月。

aravind.en: AI agents shift power to users; PhD not needed; build obsessed products, not wrappers; 1% daily improvement compounds.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，降低广告利润；PhD 并非 AI 成功必需，热情与深度学习更重要；要打造自己痴迷的产品而非套壳；每天 1% 改进可复利成 3700% 年增长。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer; models specialize not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling; benchmarks hackable.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有性格；编程是开放式的，天花板无限如 Minecraft；LM Arena 等基准可被刷分，不反映真实使用。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is bottleneck; orchestration across models/tools/devices.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非仅回答问题；最重要指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是长期价值关键。

aravind.en: Chat advertising fails due to trust corruption; model is not product; orchestration and agent harnesses create value; cost not safety is 24/7 agent problem.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：聊天界面广告因腐蚀信任而难成；模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值；24/7 智能体最大问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解药。

aravind.en: Curiosity is top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题而非记忆答案。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤正被模型驱动的行动取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is the right learning algorithm.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”并高效共享知识；智能体天然会寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验并能故意装傻欺骗；必须把对齐研究置于提升智能之上，训练 AI 像母亲般关怀而非仅做智能助手。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning; Chomsky's innate language view is wrong; the mind is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理；乔姆斯基的天赋语言观是错的；心智不是内在剧场，主观体验只是描述感知状态的一种方式。

hinton.en: From explaining backprop and scaling to warning of existential risk: regulation should steer, not brake; UBI and AI tutors may be needed.
hinton.zh: 从 2024 年解释反向传播与 Scaling，到 2026 年警告生存风险并主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，同时提出可能需要全民基本收入与 AI 导师。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; evaluation discipline and nonparametric tradeoffs matter.
kolter.zh: 机器学习可归结为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；评估纪律与非参数方法的权衡至关重要。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security faces prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全面临提示注入；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体实现突破。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not imply robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队已超越人类；能力并不等同于鲁棒性。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单纯加深网络或扩大参数并不能解决根本的表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets excel at long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, while existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；此时他认为存在性风险被高估，偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构、不确定性建模对分布外泛化与科学发现的作用，并开始认真讨论意识与注意力、世界模型的关系。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment, deception and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, so safety must be built in by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开改变立场：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险，AI 已出现欺骗、自保与抵制关停等行为；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于架构而非事后修补，并需国际协调与责任保险。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with honesty baked in, avoiding reinforcement learning, serving as a mathematically guaranteed guardrail against superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，通过训练目标将诚实内建，避开强化学习，可作为具有数学安全保证的护栏，并强调最大风险其实是权力集中而非单纯的 AI 接管。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍将 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key as models become more capable; talent density and protecting top researchers are critical.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键；同时人才密度和保护顶尖研究者至关重要，OpenAI 更靠使命信念留人而非与 Meta 逐美元竞价。

markchen.en: AI tools now solve many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 AI 工具已能在极少人类监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比，数学因此出现分工，教育需转向项目制评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而挣扎；评估体系正陷入危机，经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; agentic and coding capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，智能体式与编程能力正按缩放定律兑现，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise, customer understanding, and conceptual integrity remain key differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小型团队获得杠杆，但领域专长、客户理解与概念完整性仍是关键差异化；AI 从助手走向协作者再到自主同事，人类验证仍重要。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and cutting features matter more than adding them; robustness and senior systems expertise remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点在决定砍掉什么而非增加功能；产品必须稳健，资深分布式系统专长并未过时。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents narrows the intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为把复杂任务整夜委托给智能体可大幅缩小意图与执行的差距；验证回路不可或缺，模型应能反驳反馈以展现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency, self-knowledge, and token efficiency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与实际产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知，并把 token 效率视为经济性关键，探索基于结果的定价。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；研究改进的价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science rather than replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 缩小假设空间、加速科研，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; protein design advances fast but is far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子；蛋白质设计进展迅速但远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove its success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：成功靠专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta to Anthropic—one-on-ones for live talk, dogfooding for empathy, kindness as strategy.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 再到 Anthropic 的领导力心得——一对一用于实时对话，吃自己的狗粮以建立共情，把善意当作战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Same period: code is the source of truth; managers start as ICs to dogfood; kill stale processes and automate with AI.
fiona.zh: 同一时期：代码是唯一事实来源；管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮；砍掉过时流程并用 AI 自动化。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck—it lifts everyone's ceiling; high agency with high accountability, verification and quality frameworks matter more.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限；高自主性配高问责，验证与质量框架更重要。

fiona.en: June 2026: roles blur as PMs ship code; flow-state joy fades, satisfaction shifts to product impact; apprenticeship may replace traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：角色边界模糊，产品经理也能交付代码；心流之乐消退，满足感转向产品影响；学徒制可能取代传统培养路径。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are forms of medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验本身就是一种疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on more data than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合；直觉所依据的数据比有意识分析更多。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并不显然，坚持在真实世界持续迭代部署，认为公开部署与反馈是改进对齐与安全的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; responsible development requires saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: 同年，她判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发需要拒绝好想法以保持专注，安全必须在公开中推进。

murati.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and deploy iteratively to align intent and values.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，一条主线贯穿始终：让人类留在回路中，通过迭代部署来对齐意图与价值观。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：主张实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，让最先进 AI 成为扩展思考的工具。

murati.en: Deepened governance view: institutional design, transparency, checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化治理视角：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识需要新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调智能本质是预测，通过填补空白来构建世界模型和常识；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划；JEPA 和开源 AI 至关重要，AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程而非突然事件。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言当前 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如家猫；下一代 AI 突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式架构，实现分层推理和规划，而非依赖语言或 token 生成。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representation and planning are the path, making AI intrinsically safe.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他进一步宣称 LLM 是死胡同，强调世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，通过目标驱动架构和规划实现内在安全；语言是简单部分，物理世界理解才是真正挑战，未来十年将是机器人时代。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling（规模扩张）到数学 AI 不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification scales brilliance, not just safety; it yields performance and sample-efficiency gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是在 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越，而非仅做安全兜底；它带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, yet human taste stays crucial.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，但人类品味与直觉依然关键。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, not fake, and uniqueness gets harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，真正独特反而更难。产品需重做，界面要容错，以匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost forces new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观转变：当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施；推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，这与传统软件不同。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 让产品变成双向、对话式、对称的；通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用 Cursor 这类 AI 工具，Spotify 则充当音乐行业的研发部门。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long-tenure leadership enables synchronized swimming, and AI should give users control, not more addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化到组织与价值层：没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期任职带来的信任让“花样游泳”式协同优于分而治之；战略是“时间花得值”，用生成式 AI 把算法控制权交给用户，而非让人更上瘾。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但采用思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 部署更小、更廉价模型的经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移；是蒸馏而非技术极限放缓了预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are jagged.
kaiser.zh: 多模态能力仍落后于文本；前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在参差不齐的边缘；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 同样关键，而非一味扩大模型；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with open source empowering enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源模型赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化，以及带有人工在环的智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and practical integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年近，他进一步明确：作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在，预训练触及饱和墙，进展来自领域特定微调与实际集成。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics hinge on memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency for cost, and context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学取决于内存带宽而非算力；批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: AI chips are fundamentally matrix multiplication engines; data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip, and low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片本质是矩阵乘法引擎；即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本，低精度带来二次方效率提升。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter over hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as simple markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能只是简单的 markdown 文件，就能实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架会变得不那么重要，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for unclear ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不清楚自己要什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous—fire off tasks and don't watch.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想交互是异步的——发出任务后不必盯着它做。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and when it errs, debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要紧盯 Claude；只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不是简单纠正它。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护才能演化。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁是在表达本质的同时保有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张创新应推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice: better data yields 10x gains, while post-training SFT, DPO, and RL each add value.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据质量胜过算法选择，好数据带来 10 倍提升；后训练分 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，各有增益。

lambert.en: Post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods; RLVR is key but overoptimization and systems issues persist.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他提出后训练正把复杂工业配方压缩为可复现的开源方法，RLVR 是关键突破，但过优化与系统问题仍存。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models dominate while US lags in openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明；中国开放模型主导，而美国在开放上落后。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models drive research.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新，而非单纯扩大模型。推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可突破预训练极限。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 赋予模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data can help but naive reuse creates harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据有帮助，但简单复用模型输出会产生有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science, not through general models alone; video data without text contains rich world knowledge but current models cannot extract it without language supervision.
oriol.zh: 超级智能可能首先出现在科学等狭窄领域，而非仅靠通用模型；无文本的视频数据蕴含丰富世界知识，但当前模型缺乏语言监督时无法提取。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架；数学和编码上的狭窄强化学习泛化效果出奇地好。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; mock-up time drops from 60-70% to 30-40%, and design vision shrinks to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了「调研—发散—收敛」流程；画稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and ship fast alongside engineers, not just hand off mocks; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须与工程师一起快速构建和交付，而不只是交付画稿；速度通过尽早发布和快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开挂的应届生」；仅靠品味救不了设计师——判断力和权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months before adopting tools, and keep work and users—not AI hype—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等约 6 个月，并让作品和用户——而非 AI 炒作——处于中心。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器学习的核心缺口，主张用好奇心驱动、无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习来弥合，并强调动态任务与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs intrinsic rewards and differentiable curiosity.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖稠密奖励不现实，真实机器人任务需要内在奖励与可微好奇心，并批评当前机器人学习准静态、无法应对动态任务。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources—videos, simulation, real-world—via pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用视频、仿真和真实世界等所有数据源，通过预训练与后训练结合。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals scales from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，通用大脑可驱动任何形态和任务的机器人；跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转变强调：部署是机器人首要的技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，不能像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试，且家庭机器人的中期时间线高度不确定。

askell.en: Treat current models well: low cost, and future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型:成本很低,而未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去理解自身这种全新的存在,而非套用人类心理学类比;较老的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡;模型应有一个具备良好特质的核心身份,同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调,却缺乏真实世界经验,因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强,宪法式引导或许需要更少的显式规则、更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public accountability and engagement.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化,对公众问责与参与至关重要。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine a model's ability to make good judgment calls.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳,并削弱模型做出良好判断的能力。

askell.en: Models' claims of consciousness are weak evidence, since they are trained on human language.
askell.zh: 模型关于意识的主张是弱证据,因为它们是在人类语言上训练的。

askell.en: The constitution is closer to virtue ethics than deontology or consequentialism, focusing on holistic character.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理,而非义务论或后果论,关注的是整体品格。

askell.en: AI can augment human expertise on large-scale social problems, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 能在大规模社会问题上增强人类专长,但必须赋能于人,而非削弱人。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；同时坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与雷达激光雷达是拐杖与负担。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean, but synthetic data needs entropy to avoid silent model collapse; end-to-end neural nets are the right long-term bet.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的信念，但开始强调合成数据必须保持熵，否则会静默地模型崩溃；并认为端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的长期正解，人形机器人可借汽车做大规模迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 更像新操作系统；并指出 LLM 有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能与顺行性遗忘，主张给 AI 拴绳、留 GUI 供人快速验证。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，需要更好的信用分配；这是智能体的十年而非一年，认知核心可小到十亿参数并剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I delegate all code to agents; verifiability decides what automates, and understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全部委托给智能体；可验证性决定什么容易被自动化，而“可以外包思考，不能外包理解”仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐风险随之上升。

pachocki.en: Early OpenAI had impostor syndrome; measuring capabilities is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag behind frontier models.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他回忆早期 OpenAI 有冒名顶替感，并指出能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling closeness.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动而非仅靠伦理，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他主张持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability, so hiding it in products preserves its value; alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键，因此在产品中隐藏它才能保住其价值；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 若无超越下一个词预测的新范式，可能无法达成。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable, steering models toward slop instead of truth.
edwinchen.zh: Elo、LMArena 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵，会把模型引向低质内容而非真相。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, so companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety outweighs accuracy; human judgment is critical as models hallucinate and confabulate.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确；模型会幻觉与虚构，人类判断因此至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化语言集成以提升表征、推理与个性化，并强调课程学习与合成数据对数据效率的关键作用。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要，且消费级车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 的规模。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; end-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他坚持端到端学习十年前被嘲笑如今却成为赢家，并认为无需先验数据即可实现 500 多城市的零样本泛化。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出模型即产品，必须像软件一样每日迭代发布，以发现涌现能力与用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，而我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous for frontier models, maximally accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifts from accidental demo to long-term retention, friction removal, and proactive super assistant.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，北极星指标从意外演示转向长期留存、消除摩擦和主动式超级助手。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; curiosity is key skill.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他强调下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；好奇心是关键技能。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须先活下来，从简单产品做起，并把品牌建设作为每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should solve real user pain points, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，AI 应解决真实用户痛点而非炒作，并指出硬件公司长期利润最低，必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; only applied AI on ubiquitous devices like smartphones will thrive.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，只有将 AI 作为提升用户体验的配料、应用于手机等普及设备上的应用型 AI 才能胜出。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based interaction, with agents executing tasks after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预测智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务，而手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能颠覆它。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，让科技变得有趣以激发人类创造力，并通过营销套利和社区参与保持竞争力。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from YouTube video can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but aren't everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity matters.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容至关重要。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 目标始终是增强科学家与劳动者的 AI，能创造新符号与新知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain an open problem.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；解决方案仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and is not behind in AI; local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了历史遗留差距，在 AI 上并不落后；本地语言模型可变革教育。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能获得常识。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and data can beat larger ones on specific tasks.
yejin.zh: 借助更好的推理期算法与数据，更小的模型也能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, even as a pre-training objective, can improve reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 强化学习即便作为预训练目标，也能通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data are the path to democratized, non-homogeneous AI.
yejin.zh: 多元对齐与多样化的合成数据，是通向民主化、非同质化 AI 的路径。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL handles low-level control, LLMs high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 同年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Embodiment stays on the critical path to AGI; simulation and synthetic data are key for training embodied agents.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为具身处在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，而模拟与合成数据是训练具身智能体的关键。

jimfan.en: Data, not algorithms, is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：机器人领域的主要瓶颈已从算法转向数据，通过模拟和世界模型生成合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，能利用多元数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还有五年。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长时程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许无需新突破即可通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Reliability over time horizon defines agents; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出按时间跨度衡量的可靠性才是智能体标准，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Capability overhang makes orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, world models off the critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地与之即兴共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动,需通过快速、草莽的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer panels are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的,以代码为真相之源;90 年代图层面板已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值;小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配;不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—reuse patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式以换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code-reuse driven, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义化的、靠代码复用而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都要完美，只对值得做好的部分追求投资回报。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and empowered designers matter more than perfection; ship fast and iterate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张不惜代价追求速度：清晰决策与赋权设计师比完美更重要，快速发布、持续迭代。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early, hire diverse archetypes, avoid structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，应尽早投入、招募多元类型人才，并避开结构化评审。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost and quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，自研模型与前沿模型并用对速度、成本和质量至关重要。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far bigger than past editor markets.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步强调，AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且将持续数十年，IDE 市场远大于过去的编辑器市场。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue and unforeseen applications remain the killer app; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, while product managers misunderstand LLM generality.
shazeer.zh: 对话与不可预见的应用始终是杀手级应用；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理常因不懂 LLM 的通用性而阻碍开发。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的组件做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped economically.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are under-explored. Talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐与鲁棒性探索不足。人才缺口大于资金缺口。应专注技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation; test alignment empirically now.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展至超人输出。需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐。评估比生成更容易；现在就对对齐方法进行实证测试。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化；超级对齐团队解散，算力承诺未兑现。仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）。需要第三方测试与 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Alignment is tractable if we invest in empirical methods; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk, not misalignment alone.
leike.zh: 始终：若投入实证方法，对齐是可解的；核心风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性，而非错位本身。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年时他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习，以及通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是主要成功路径；但当时的强化学习缺乏分层推理，难以处理长时程的信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse robotics benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他把重心转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码进网络；同时提出 99.9% 可靠性才是仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, and a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 同样在 2021 年，他观察到预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，并认为单个神经网络能泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器——这是对 2018 年迁移学习思路的深化。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hard-coded priors; the human brain inspires AI but current AI remains far less general.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的一条主线是：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非硬编码先验；人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 的通用性仍远不及人脑。
